panel_line: Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc
After Yoru manages to emerge victorious, she attempts to turn Pochita into a weapon.
Synopsis / Academy Saga / War Devil arc
After forcibly giving Denji another kiss and questioning if he wants sex, Yoru makes a proposal that if he defeats the Death Devil, he can have sex with her.
Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / International Assassins arc
Denji is happy to be seen on TV, while Makima is visibly infuriated, and comments on the prospect of Reze fulfilling her task and talks about how other countries are going to want to steal his heart.
Asa then shoots herself in the head at the same moment Miri Sugo slices Yoru in half, while the Death Devil summons the Guillotine Devil to shred Yoru’s body.
Although confused by how easy it was to take down "Death" herself, the imposter assures himself that he did the right thing.
Body Assimilation: Pochita can fuse with a human body, restoring it to full health in the process.
Blood Manipulation: Power can freely manipulate the blood in her body to form weapons.(Chapter 5)
Gravity Manipulation: The Falling Devil can selectively manipulate gravity on herself, the environment, multiple objects or individual people.
Death herself possesses all the standard Devil abilities.
Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / Control Devil arc
By then, she abandons Makima's plans of bringing out Pochita and instead lives out her life with Denji and their pets.(Chapter 155)
Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / Control Devil arc
Denji and Power are left alone with half of Aki’s money in a new apartment, which he left to Denji, spending it on food to cope with Aki’s demise.
After waiting over the course of three days for the battle between Denji and the Eternity Devil to be over, Kobeni sits in the corner in an exhausted state.(Chapter 19)
Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / Bat Devil arc
Denji also agrees with Aki on forgetting about the Bat Devil incident, and plays dumb to prevent Power from being executed.
Asa is a high school girl of average height.
Fumiko Mifune is a jolly young woman with short black hair.
Santa Claus’s main body is presumed to be a dark blue-haired, green eyed woman with a mole under her eye.
The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body.
At some point, Denji killed his father out of self-defense, as the latter was in a drunken aggressive state and he feared for his life.
This drove her to Earth where she would begin searching for a new body to possess in a last-ditch effort to save herself, as well as getting her revenge on Chainsaw Man.(Chapter 104)
It turned out that the caretaker had lied to Asa and killed Crambon because she was jealous that Asa still had someone she considered family.(Chapter 123)
Due to heavy media coverage of gun crimes in every country, worldwide fear of guns has increased drastically.(Chapter 13)
Following this incident, Makima had the Angel Devil captured and enlisted him as a member of Public Safety.(Chapter 42)
Denji is both brash and naïve as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty, making him generally crass and vulgar.
Asa is a quiet and unsociable girl, who dislikes her classmates, frequently wishing they would drop dead and spurning any offers of friendship.(Chapter 98)

Power is an insatiable glutton, eating all of the stored food that the team needed in order to survive the Eternity Devil's trap and hoarding food for herself at the Division 4's newbie welcoming party.(Chapter 17)(Chapter 20)

Befitting her status as the Famine Devil, Fami is also a major glutton, frequently ordering inhuman levels of food to consume in a single setting and sometimes eating it without any utensils, seen when she messily eats a giant plate of spaghetti with her bare hands and no thought of the mess on her face from the marinara sauce.(Chapter 122)(Chapter 163)
